source: كتاب تجميعات يلو للرياضيات 26 - النسخة المعدلة.pdf
scope: source-backed answer key verification for 13 source pages and 154 questions
method: Read actual PDF page text and printed answer-key grid; align source page and printed question number with MongoDB canonical row; compare source key letter to stored correctOptionIndex; verify source page metadata, hash and expected main lesson.
warning: This verifies the source answer-key cell, NOT mathematical correctness, full image crop, all option texts or full pedagogy. Rows with mismatches are not automatically changed.

rows.reviewScope: source page/question number + printed answer-key cell + current taxonomy main + core metadata
